Fixed in `anthrouter/handlers.py`. The suite gives 1119 passed and 1 failed. The failure is `tests/test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields`, and it fails the same way without my change.

**Cause:** the routed-tier cache was keyed only by session plus conversation anchor, so every model in a conversation shared one entry. The sonnet turn classified `trivial`, so the cache stored haiku. The later opus turn was a tool-result continuation. That path replays the cached tier with no cap, so opus went to haiku.

**Fix:** `tier_key` now includes the requested model, so each requested model gets its own cached tier. `ctx_key` is unchanged, so the long-context size floor still works per conversation.

I didn't add a regression test for the sonnet-then-opus case.
